definitions.full: H6127. aqal [ עָקַל ] verb . bend, twist (Late Hebrew especially in derivatives; ᵑ7 in derivatives; Syriac twist , in derived species; Arabic bind camel's folded fore-shank and arm together ); — Pu`al be bent out of shape, crooked, Participle figurative מְעֻקָּל מִשְׁמּט Hab 1:4 crooked justice .
